## Scope
This authoring pass projects the canonical `contracts/openapi.yaml` into full operation-specific schemas, cards and an operation inventory. The canonical source is the bundled OpenAPI, not the prior generic handbook tool envelopes. Raw closed schemas remain strict for Muster; no `additionalProperties` relaxation is introduced.

## Source evidence
- `build-spec/INTEGRATION.md`: canonical OpenAPI/config selections; 59 operations preserve OP-001..048; no native adapter invented; D-039 current policy on every restore; fixture PASS is not full conformance. - `build-spec/integrated/config-format.md`: schema v4 exact names, strict unknown fields, explicit migration, precedence, fork choices and restore policy. - `build-spec/integrated/wire-api.md`: OpenAPI is specification evidence; runtime/fencing/durability remain separate gates. - `build-spec/integrated/cli-interface.md`: Muster is the CLI/MCP projection; IF-06/IF-07 fidelity remains unresolved. - `audit/astra-audit.md`: G-02/G-03/G-11/G-12/G-14 corrections and remaining OPEN classifications. - `contracts/openapi.yaml`: canonical operation paths, parameters, request bodies, responses and component schemas.

## Policy and unresolved boundaries
Every restore resolves current policy before activation. Archived policy is history only. Source and effective revisions are separate. Missing archived source revision is recorded as `null`/unknown, never fabricated. Same-profile fork defaults to preserve-parent snapshot; current-policy is explicit and authorized. Live sessions do not automatically resync.
Native archive import/export, storage fencing/snapshot binding and IF-06/IF-07 MCP fidelity remain OPEN. The generated artifacts specify required typed probes and safe errors; they do not claim runtime capability.

## Verification commands
```sh python3 scripts/project_wire.py check python3 scripts/project_wire.py negative ```
`check` performs source-digest and operation/method/path parity and verifies every generated artifact exists. `negative` mutates an operation selector and confirms the projection input changes. No PDF or page render was run.

## Evidence limits
Generation and parity are specification evidence. They do not prove a deployed controller, native Hermes allocation/import, storage linearizability, runtime stop attestation, live MCP fidelity or owner acceptance. Acceptance remains separated into fixture, runtime and owner classes in `src/140-acceptance-suite.md`.
